note: Inbox copy (js/state/inbox.js stores the kind and variables; the screen picks a line from here). Each kind has from (sender), title and body lists

title: Season objective: {goal}

Objective for the season — {goal}
body: The board's objective for this season is: {goal}. The players and supporters alike have high hopes.
{team}'s objective for the season has been set: {goal}. Meet it and the board's faith in you will only grow stronger.
The board expects the following this season: {goal}. Please bear in mind that confidence will rise and fall with results.

title: Board concerns
A warning over results
A response is needed

title: Ultimatum

body: Players who didn't renew their contracts are now on the market. Several clubs are competing with signing-on fees. We can bid too, and the players will choose their destinations after the round {round} matches.

Other clubs are showing interest in the players released at the end of their contracts (total: {count}). Search with 'Free agents only' on the transfers screen and put in a signing-on fee. Decisions come after the round {round} matches.
